title: Evaluate dynamic quant profiles and latency scaling for long-horizon workloads
creator: Maya Kapoor
description: Background: We've onboarded several FP8 and INT8 quant profiles for the Llama-variant family. Early microbenchmarks show promising per-token savings, but production traffic patterns (variable batch sizes, KV-cache warmup, and very long contexts >8k tokens) produce non-linear latency behavior and occasional accuracy regressions. Goal: produce an operational guidance and automated selection heuristics that choose between FP8/INT8 and mixed profiles based on request characteristics, while quantifying throughput, p50/p95/p99 latency, and accuracy delta for long-horizon scenarios. Scope: 1) Design a benchmark harness that replays synthetic and sampled production traces with variable batch distributions and warm/cold KV cache states. 2) Run full factorial experiments across quant profiles (FP8 dynamic, INT8 static, mixed), sequence lengths (2k/8k/20k), and batching strategies (fixed, dynamic, continuous batching) to measure throughput and latency tails. 3) Calibrate INT8 using current calibration pipeline and record calibration stability metrics. 4) Produce a dashboard with interactive slices and a recommendation algorithm for runtime selection. Out of scope: re-training or model architecture changes. Deliverables: benchmark dataset, results dashboard, PR with runtime selection heuristic, and a short runbook for rolling out changes to Dedicated clusters.
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark harness can replay sampled production traces and synthetic edge cases with configurable batch distributions and KV-cache states
Completed runs for all combinations: quant profiles (FP8, INT8, mixed), seq lens (2k, 8k, 20k), batching policies (fixed, dynamic, continuous)
Documented p50/p95/p99 latencies and throughput numbers for each variant and a one-page summary highlighting best/worst trade-offs

Accuracy validation: end-to-end comparison on eval prompt set with measured metric deltas (perplexity and chosen downstream LLM QA accuracy); any regression >1.5% must be flagged with root cause analysis
Recommendation algorithm (rule-based + thresholds) merged to runtime repo behind feature flag and validated on canary traffic with automated rollback on SLO breach
Dashboard link + exportable CSV with raw experiment matrices available for reviewers
